sentences.en: I foolishly interpreted the idiom according to its literal sense.

sentences.en: Why does English have so many idioms and phrasal verbs?

sentences.en: The teacher said that we must memorize these idioms.
sentences.zh: 老师说我们必须记住这些惯用语。

senses.zh: 习语，成语,方言，土语,（语言）风格,惯用语法
